en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with 19th‑century style buildings and a tall Gothic church with multiple spires and a clock tower in the center background. Along the square are two‑ and three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs. Ground floors host several shops and businesses with German‑language signs, including a pharmacy (Apotheke) and a cafe/restaurant. A horse‑drawn carriage stands in the street and a few people sit at tables or sell goods in the open square, suggesting a market scene.
